subject: Weekend Plans
text: I need advice for our project outing. The Saturday plan changed. A repair bill arrived. It was unexpected. It raised costs. We cannot go out as planned. I want to keep the hike. It will still be nice. The lake trail is free. We can meet at nine. Bring only water and snacks. No restaurant stop. This will help the budget. I have already paid for the van. That was a mistake. It cost too much. I do not want to cancel friends. I think a simple morning is best. Please let me know if this works. I can cover half if needed. Do not reply with stress. Just say yes or no. We can adjust quickly. Thanks for understanding.
